# `/password-policies` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /password-policies/v1/{id}

`getPasswordPolicyByIdV1` — Get password policy by id — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns the password policy for the specified ID.

- Scopes: idn:password-policy:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of password policy to retrieve.
- Returns 200: passwordpolicyv3dto

`setPasswordPolicyV1` — Update password policy by id — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of password policy to update.
